verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments layer for AI agents, with a dashboard, wallets and transaction data, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers tokens, KYA verification, charging, settlement, wallet balances and an MCP server for agents. Nothing in the pack documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
